english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for consuming a liquid, including the contents of a container and alcohol when the context is clear.

examples.english: I drink a cup of coffee every morning.
examples.traditional: 我每日朝早都飲杯咖啡。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2 dou1 jam2 bui1 gaa3 fe1
